assumptions.text: Room assumed about 5 x 5.5 m with a 3.2 m ceiling, estimated from the door and bed.
Camera in the south-west corner area looking north-north-east with a wide lens.
The window is assumed to sit behind the east curtains; the photo does not show it. The ceiling is modelled flat although it is vaulted.
